integrity: The infinite theorem is proved symbolically. Exhaustive computation through order 9 is used only as a finite stress test and coefficient check, not as a proof of the unbounded statement.
scientific_limitations: Specific to closed-neighborhood k-limited packing on finite connected complete multipartite graphs. Earlier LAGOS'07/2008 literature contains the complete-bipartite special case; its exact public posting day was not independently verified, so the date field uses the earliest verified day-level public timestamp among the anchor sources inspected.
title: All \(k\)-limited packings of complete multipartite graphs
